crossRefs.note: When he was alone, those who were around him with the twelve asked him about the parables.
Without a parable he didn’t speak to them; but privately to his own disciples he explained everything.
The disciples came, and said to him, “Why do you speak to them in parables?”
Then Jesus sent the multitudes away, and went into the house. His disciples came to him, saying, “Explain to us the…
Peter answered him, “Explain the parable to us.”
Then the disciples came to Jesus privately, and said, “Why weren’t we able to cast it out?”
He said to them, “Because of your unbelief. For most certainly I tell you, if you have faith as a grain of mustard…

translations.web: When he had come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, “Why couldn’t we cast it out?”
translations.bsb: After Jesus had gone into the house, His disciples asked Him privately, “Why couldn’t we drive it out?”
translations.kjv: And when he was come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, Why could not we cast him out?
translations.asv: And when he was come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, How is it that we could not cast it out?
